recap.text: Chaco welcomes the crawlers to the Prize Carousel. He puts Mordecai in time-out for seven days. Carl looks at the prizes and picks a book.

Chaco tells Carl that surviving in this place makes a person turn on their own party. He expresses regret for an action that saved Chaco, his brother, and others from death. Chaco then announces sixty-six hunter hands arriving as prize boxes for Carl.

Magnificent Troy refuses to come down to the surface, so Chaco serves as the field correspondent with a lint roller. Kevin stays in the orbit studio with Gravy Boat and Juice Box. Carl tells Chaco to get out of his face while Princess Donut and Ferdinand laugh at King Stalwart's crown. Chaco asks for a vote on if King Stalwart looks stupid.

Chaco is voluntold by the AI to be Grand Master of a parade. He tells crawlers they have ninety minutes to build float processions for a three kilometre route. Chaco stops reading the script due to stage fright, so the AI removes his wings and replaces him with Grigori.

beats.headline: The Prize Carousel
beats.text: Crawlers, welcome to the Prize Carousel! Our contestant's fan box lit up the wheel, and when the wheel lights up, folks, that means me! And a twist before we even start: your guide is in time-out. Seven days, Mordecai, nothing personal, put your feet up. Now, to the prizes! Carl looks them over and picks... a book. A book, folks! Let's hear it for a man who knows exactly what he wants!
beats.gist: Chaco welcomes crawlers to the Prize Carousel and puts Mordecai in time-out for seven days.

beats.headline: They make you turn on your party
beats.text: He asks me again why Mordecai hates me, and I am still not allowed to say. Tell him I'm sorry. I regret it every day. If we hadn't done it, we'd all be dead, including him and his brother. And a little something from your host: survive long enough in this place and they make you turn on your own party. It happens every time. Then I take a deep breath and wipe my face, and it's prize time! Carl, folks! Sixty-six hunter hands! Everything arrives as a prize box!
beats.gist: Chaco asks why Mordecai hates Carl; Carl receives sixty-six hunter hands in prize boxes.

beats.headline: Your field correspondent
beats.text: Folks, Magnificent Troy refused to come down to the surface, so I have been voluntold as your field correspondent, lint roller and all! Kevin is in the studio in orbit. Hello, Gravy Boat. Hello, Juice Box. Tension hangs heavy in the air as the hunter and the hunted stare at each other! Carl, how do you feel right now? Carl says to get this out of his face. Princess Donut and Ferdinand cannot stop laughing at King Stalwart's crown. Does King Stalwart look stupid wearing the crown? Let's vote!
beats.gist: Chaco acts as field correspondent with a lint roller while Kevin stays in orbit.

beats.headline: Voluntold as Grand Master
beats.text: Oh, hey, crawlers! Your boy Chaco here, and I have just been voluntold by the AI to be Grand Master of the parade! Ninety minutes to build your float processions, folks. Five groups, five themes. Three kilometres of route, spectators on both sides who cannot attack you, a judging stand, and then an arena full of everything you killed on the tenth, plus a floor boss. Beat the boss and the stairwell opens. Simple. I guess. I don't really understand it either. And then, under the feedback: oh shit, oh shit, I'm gonna die.
beats.gist: The AI voluntolds Chaco to be Grand Master of a parade with float processions.

beats.headline: He cannot get through the script
beats.text: Chaco had one job: read the script. He got partway in, looked up, and stopped. Stage fright, on my stage. So I removed his wings, which he was not using anyway, and brought Grigori up to finish the reading. I'm doing Grigori's talking myself; it saves time. A presenter is a mouth with a costume on it, crawler, and mouths can be replaced. Wings, apparently, cannot.
beats.gist: Chaco stops reading the script due to stage fright, so the presenter removes his wings.

relations.note: Spent his scalps at the prize counter
